    (function (base, dir, sub) {
        var basedir = `${base}/${dir}`, fpath = `${basedir}/${sub}.xml`;
        if (!sub) {
            return fs.statSync(basedir).isDirectory() ? fs.readdirSync(basedir).filter(sub=>fs.statSync(`${basedir}/${sub}`).isFile()).map(sub=>include(`${dir}/${sub}`)).join('') : undefined
        } else if (fs.existsSync(fpath) && fs.statSync(fpath).isFile()) {
            return include(`${dir}/${sub}.xml`)
        }
    })(path.dirname(__filename), 'features', query['Caller-Destination-Number']) // __dirname, 'features', '1000'
 %>
